notes.title: Box #341 is now LIVE on Steam! 📦
notes.content:
After months of hard work, I’m thrilled to announce that Box #341 is now officially live on Steam! 🥳
This cozy puzzle platformer is all about clever mechanics, charming characters, and that satisfying "aha!" moment when a puzzle clicks.

🌊 You play as a wooden box navigating through a mysterious warehouse, soaking up different liquids to gain quirky powers—stick to walls, bounce higher, flip gravity, and more!

💡 Whether you love relaxed puzzle games, atmospheric vibes, or just want something new to chill with, I’d love for you to check it out!

💛 If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review, wishlisting, or sharing it with a friend—it helps a ton!

notes.title: Release date announement trailer Launch!
notes.content:
Box #341 is launching on April 21, 2025! 🎉 Get ready to flip, dip, and solve puzzles in this cozy warehouse adventure.

Guide a wooden box through a mechanical warehouse, using liquids to gain unique abilities, navigate challenging levels, and meet quirky characters along the way!
